title: Neutrino Target Profile
description: A machine-readable declaration of which semantic primitives a rendering target supports (M5 WP4, ). The canonical spec's targetRequirements are matched against a profile's supportedFeatures BEFORE rendering; an unsupported feature fails closed with a legality diagnostic naming the feature, the originating primitive, and its source line ( taxonomy). Profiles key on semantic FEATURES (value_category:*, effect:*, invariant:*, binding:*, topology:*) — the same strings the spec emits — never on domain/contract labels. Fail-closed (additionalProperties:false). Validated by scripts/validators/validate_target_profile.py; the matcher is scripts/gates/check_spec_legality.py. Versioning per M5 addendum AD3. See docs/backends/TARGET_PROFILES.md.

feature.description: A semantic feature string as emitted in the spec's targetRequirements: <dimension>:<value> (e.g. value_category:money, effect:debit, topology:org_coordination).

limit.description: A non-negative numeric cap on a parameterized coordination-plan metric.

profileId.description: <family>.<name>.v<major>; its v<major> must equal profileVersion. Stable shape identifier used for matching (AD3).

target.description: The generation target this profile governs (e.g. solidity, postgres).

runtimeFamily.description: WHERE the rendered artifact runs — the runtime-family axis (distinct from executionMode). Matches the binding policy's allowed runtime family.

executionMode.description: The assurance-relevant execution mode (): deterministic (compiler-attested, replayable, no external state) / simulated (validated in a test/sim harness, not production custody) / real (production runtime with real custody). A simulated backend must not be treated as carrying real-money assurance.

supportedFeatures.description: The semantic features this target can render. A spec requirement whose feature is absent here fails closed (unless it is optional and fallbackPolicy permits).

unsupportedConstructs.description: Features explicitly declared unsupported — a hard, documented denial (yields a distinct diagnostic from a merely-absent feature). Must be disjoint from supportedFeatures.

fallbackPolicy.description: What to do when an OPTIONAL spec requirement is unmet: fail_closed (treat like a required violation) or advisory (record, allow).

capabilitySpecVersion.description: The capability-spec CONTRACT version this profile was authored against, pinning the translator's emitted kCapabilitySpecVersion. Enforced fail-closed by scripts/gates/check_artifact_pins.py (R3/): a mismatch with the core's emitted contract version is rejected. Distinct from profileVersion (this profile's own revision).

semanticProfile.description: The semantic realization capability (): the normalized-transition semantic features + parameterized limits this target realizes, matched against a verified CoordinationPlan's requirements BEFORE evaluator/lowering dispatch (the plan-legality gate). `version` pins the DISTINCT semantic-profile contract (VersionInfo.h kSemanticProfileVersion) — NOT schemaVersion or profileVersion; a missing/unknown version fails closed. `features` are the supported closed-registry semantic requirements (authorization:*, effect:*, guard:*, invariant:*, attestation:*, terminal:* shapes, replay:*); a required feature absent here is refused. `limits` bound parameterized plan metrics (expression depth, effect/group/attestation/compute counts) — a plan exceeding a cap is refused.
